contentHtml:
Property management services in Hackensack

Tenant placement

We market your Hackensack rental across top listing platforms. Every applicant goes through income verification on the tenant’s share of the rent, a credit and rental history review, and background screening as New Jersey law allows.

Rent collection

Automated online collection with direct owner disbursements. Late fees handled per NJ law. Real-time visibility in your owner portal.

Maintenance coordination

24/7 tenant maintenance requests. Vendor network covering Bergen County. Owners approve repairs above their stated threshold.

Financial reporting

Monthly owner statements and 24/7 portal access.

NJ compliance

PPM stays current on Hackensack and statewide NJ landlord-tenant law — security deposits, habitability, lease requirements, and eviction procedures.

The Hackensack rental market

Hackensack is the Bergen County seat and one of its densest rental markets — a walkable downtown that has seen a wave of new mid-rise apartments alongside established two- and three-family neighborhoods. Bus and rail links toward the George Washington Bridge and Midtown make it a commuter favorite, and the county courthouse, Hackensack University Medical Center, and area offices keep a steady base of professional renters.

The mix runs from new luxury mid-rises to older multi-family and single-family rentals. Pricing to the right sub-market and turning units quickly is where returns are made.
